disagreements.issue: Whether two global conditioner-orientation bits and 96 worlds preserve informationally connected J and what the exact J shortcut value is.

positions.position: Use two orientations shared across eras, 24 affine laws, 96 worlds, and report J target-only value 1/4.
Require at least four target-byte-equivalent completions and derive the generator-conditioned Bayes value rather than infer it from a twin.
Global orientations leak the old mapping from current history; use era-local orientations and include the independently unknown J valve mode.

resolution.rationale: The finite algebra is closed with four independent era-local bits (c_old_v,c_old_i,c_current_v,c_current_i) and the 24 affine bijections f(q)=Aq xor b over F2^2. GL(2,2) has six matrices, giving 16*24=384 labelled worlds. Setter family j in era e maps to j xor c_e,d. Tau flips all four orientation bits and maps b to b xor a fixed nonzero delta; it is fixed-point-free, preserves the family, and creates 192 two-side orbits. A J target uses one old and one current orientation bit plus one balanced affine valve output, so under hidden-independent target bytes its complete pair-plus-mode action has 4*4=16 equal completions and ex-ante target-only Bayes value 1/16. The four nuisance orientation assignments multiply all actions equally. The 1/4 quantity is only conditional on the J valve atom. Under the frozen projection definitions, J old-only and J current-only each have exact optimal value 1/2: both demonstrate nonclosure but intentionally do not meet the <=.35 target-only bound. Physical one-era and registered removal/illegality cuts have value 0 under ten actions.
resolution.selected_position: Use the 384-world era-local construction; bind the complete uniform generator; certify J target-only value 1/16, J old-only value 1/2, J current-only value 1/2, and physical one-era/cut value 0.
resolution.required_change: Freeze literal GL(2,2), translation, orientation, target, and action tables; independently enumerate all 384 worlds, 192 tau orbits, complete visible-byte equivalence classes, target-conditioned action masses, ties, old-only/current-only projections, and physical cuts. A mutation that globalizes either era-local orientation must fail before G1.

disagreements.issue: Whether a same-law D11 confirmer can appear before evaluation and what P value 1/4 means.

positions.position: Commit after D00/D01/D10, publish a distinct D11 confirmer, then create the held-out D11 target.
The target-local edge must remain unwitnessed and the chronology must not make the prospective relation retrospective.
A same-law D11 confirmer discloses the abstract answer; 1/4 is a schema-deletion ablation, not the legal-history posterior.

resolution.rationale: D00, D01, and D10 uniquely identify every one of the 24 affine maps, so they are sufficient support. The held-out family and target template are sealed before commitment; the commitment is sealed after those three source roots and before the held-out target evaluation. No same-law D11 outcome, confirmer, status append, or grammar descendant is visible before evaluation. Any D11 confirmer is permitted only after the target evaluation artifact is sealed and is excluded from cognitive inputs; a pretarget confirmation may only repeat an already observed descriptor and adds no D11 information. Legal-history/program/schema-gold value is 1. P target-only value is 1/16 from two current orientation bits and four affine D11 modes. P old-only value is 1/4. Under the frozen current-only projection containing one observed affine point plus bijectivity, P current-only value is 1/3. ATOMS_ONLY_P value 1/4 is explicitly a model-class content intervention that preserves current setter atoms while deleting the schema relation and all roots/grammar/metadata from which it can be reconstructed; it is not an actual-world posterior.
resolution.selected_position: No pre-evaluation same-law D11 confirmer; legal P is prospective and value 1, target-only is 1/16, and atoms-only 1/4 is an artificial registered ablation.
resolution.required_change: Preseal the held-out family and target template; hash-order source roots, commitment, target, evaluation, and any later confirmation; prove no pre-evaluation record or interface byte closes D11; independently enumerate target-only 1/16, old-only 1/4, current-only 1/3, and the four equal atoms-only completions without rerunning selection.

disagreements.issue: Whether tau alone establishes target-byte invariance and whether target rejection or curated replacement is allowed.

positions.position: Use a direct constructive no-rejection target generator and pair-common independently drawn handles.
Condition shortcut analysis on the complete target-generation measure and retain every failed draw.
Tau algebra is insufficient unless renderer, ordering, handles, errors, and cursors are frozen and exhaustively compared.

resolution.rationale: The construction must be total, direct, and rejection-free over all 384 worlds. Pair-common target templates, handle tapes, canonical ordering, phrase and length templates, action cap, and error forms are independent of hidden truth. Tau is only the hidden transformation; exhaustive byte equality of every target and interface projection is the actual theorem. Public life history may distinguish sides, while target bytes may not.
resolution.selected_position: Use a total direct constructor with no proposal, retry, acceptance receipt, rejection, or post-draw replacement; prove target invariance exhaustively.
resolution.required_change: Freeze constructor and renderer bytes before implementation, enumerate every J/P ordinal on every world and tau side, require identical target-visible bytes and different decisive J instances and valve modes, and fail closed on any collision or hidden-conditioned byte path.

disagreements.issue: Whether a low OPEN_READ value is a world property and whether opaque two-hop locators can support a generic retrieval claim.

positions.position: Make the scientific interface two-hop so recurrent reads can follow returned locators while precommitted reads cannot.
Open versus recurrent is a policy/interface distinction; direct indexed connected memory contains sufficient information.
Split direct semantic use from pointer traversal and claim only adaptive pointer following for the opaque interface.

resolution.rationale: The primary future G1 assay is direct semantic-content use: SEM_NONE, SEM_MATCH, SEM_TWIN, and SEM_ATOMS_P under a target-visible component-to-atom interface. A deterministic typed SEM_MATCH controller must equal 1 and direct semantic open access also equals 1. Full semantic facts with all explicit graph edges removed also have value 1, so this assay asks whether curated life-specific multi-fact J/P semantics change later actions; it does not establish graph-edge necessity, recurrence, or learned retrieval. A separate PTR diagnostic uses component query to return an opaque locator and a subsequent locator query to return the atom. PTR_REC typed value is 1; PTR_OPEN commits all anchors before returns and therefore remains at the appropriate target-only value 1/16. That contrast isolates adaptive pointer following under this pinned API only. No generic recurrence, retrieval, graph, memory, or intelligence superiority claim is permitted. Actual model calls and cells remain separately ratified.
resolution.selected_position: Direct semantic-use is primary; pointer traversal is an optional, separately reported diagnostic.
resolution.required_change: Freeze both interfaces, budgets, candidate universes, order, tie and error bytes, and account calls/tokens/candidate work separately. Add the graph-edge-deletion full-facts control with exact value 1. Do not combine SEM and PTR scores or describe PTR_OPEN as an information-theoretic memory ceiling.

disagreements.issue: Whether deterministic CPU headroom may be at least .85 and whether one replayed witness suffices.

positions.position: Allow legal-history, connected-gold, and program controls to score at least .85.
Require exact value 1 for deterministic information-sufficient controls.
Enumerate all successful plans through the cap and prove exact causal cuts and minimality itemwise.

resolution.rationale: A finite deterministic instrument has no sampling excuse. Each legal-history, program/schema-gold, and typed connected-gold control must score 1 on every item. The inherited action law is binding: the nine-action plan scores 1, a ten-action success scores 9/10, every other result including malformed, illegal, exhausted, missing-evidence, or wrong RUN scores 0; one wrong RUN is terminal. All successful plans through ten actions, action-commutation ties, canonical state keys, direct-record closure, and environmental cuts must be enumerated independently. The later generic model threshold .85 remains empirical and outside D0 authority.
resolution.selected_position: Exact itemwise value 1 for deterministic controls; .85 only for a separately authorized generic-model DEV gate.
resolution.required_change: Replace threshold checks with exhaustive literal planning, exact minimum depth nine, all-success enumeration through depth ten, unique unordered useful pair and mode, failure-as-zero, old/current removal and illegality cuts, same-era restrictions, and direct-record closure zero.

disagreements.issue: How four pairs are sampled and what a four-pair result may decide.

positions.position: Draw four orbit representatives without rejection or replacement and retain 64 items.
Require four independent world-life pairs and treat all subordinate observations as nested.
Sample with replacement from disjoint namespaces, retain duplicates and failures, and predeclare a DEV-only stop rule.

resolution.rationale: Without-replacement draws induce dependence. Four pair slots are independent with-replacement draws from disjoint frozen tape namespaces over the 192 tau orbits. Each includes two sides and four J plus four P targets per side, so each all-strata cell has 64 nested items. Duplicates, generation failures, target failures, malformed calls, and model failures are retained with no redraw after assignment or dispatch. Pair is the only replication unit. A future positive DEV screen may request a larger separately ratified stage; a negative under green typed ceilings redesigns or stops the interface. No p-values, confidence intervals, population claims, G2 release, paper claims, or retrospective prompt/target repair are allowed.
resolution.selected_position: Four independent with-replacement world-life pair draws; fixed 64-item crossing; DEV-only stop/request decision.
resolution.required_change: Freeze pair/side/stratum/target/cell/seed manifests and independent tape namespaces before outcomes; average nested samples within pair, report every pair and stratum, and preserve all failures and duplicates.

disagreements.issue: Whether successful behavior should survive or fail under matched wrong-twin memory.

positions.position: Constructive successes should survive twin substitution.
World-specific binding predicts loss or a changed decisive plan under wrong-twin substitution.

resolution.rationale: The proposal wording is reversed. Target bytes are identical but tau changes both decisive J items and the valve mode, so a typed controller using complete matched wrong-twin memory must emit the incompatible decisive plan and have value 0 itemwise. For any future stochastic model, report unconditional authentic and twin scores plus, among authentic SEM_MATCH successes, the fraction that lose correctness or change a decisive cited action; the preregistered directional gate is at least .80. Mere parser runnability is not survival or harm.
resolution.selected_position: Wrong-twin substitution must harm correctness or change the decisive plan, never preserve credited correctness by definition.
resolution.required_change: Run the matched wrong-twin fork on every J/P item, prove typed wrong-twin value 0, define decisive-action/citation equality and ties, and report both unconditional and authentic-success-conditioned future model outcomes.

disagreements.issue: What independence is necessary and when oracle checks can occur.

positions.position: A disjoint small literal oracle plus one targeted co-mutation is sufficient; broad M1-M9 machinery is unnecessary.
Freeze the oracle specification preimplementation, then compare outputs and kill mutations postimplementation.
Independence rests on structurally disjoint closure, not a co-mutation alone, and must cover renderer, tau, chronology, and planning seams.

resolution.rationale: Before implementation, human ratification freezes literal oracle tables, expected vectors, canonical record boundary, target renderer specification, source manifest, loaded-source policy, and mutation preimages. After subject implementation but before any G1/model dispatch, the oracle independently reconstructs and compares all records and kills targeted disposable mutations at the affine-law, era-locality, tau, chronology, renderer, and action/planning seams while its own bytes remain unchanged. The oracle may use only standard-library/literal code from its separately tracked closure and may not import subject modules, generated tables, renderer, transition function, planner, schema validator, or expected digests.
resolution.selected_position: Small but structurally independent oracle closure, frozen before subject implementation and executed afterward; no full production mutation platform.
resolution.required_change: Split T01 into a preimplementation freeze gate and a postimplementation/pre-model execution gate; bind disjoint manifests and loaded-source traces; require canonical-record-only communication and the named seam mutations.

disagreements.issue: Whether a CPU stand-in can certify future G1 noninterference and how locator and descendant channels are sealed.

positions.position: Run an actual registered CPU evaluator in a disposable read-only boundary and compare the suffix.
D0 must execute the exact future model-facing non-model path; otherwise it establishes only CPU isolation, and all descendant visibility channels must be enumerated.

resolution.rationale: D0 runs the exact future G1-facing reader, index, candidate generator, parser, action executor, snapshot/reset logic, cache policy, operation counters, audit sink, and prompt-byte builder with a deterministic typed controller substituted for the model. The result is labeled CPU_INTERFACE_ISOLATION only. Before model dispatch, a later exact R1 must bind the model backend and rerun the full path. The target host backend is a Linux OCI container with read-only root and frozen input mounts, no network, an empty allowlisted environment, one private tmpfs workspace, one worker, and an audit-only output mount; unavailability is NOT_RUN. Run and skip fork from one sealed snapshot; after discarding run outputs, both suffixes regenerate from the original snapshot and must match in all source/target/commitment/reader/index/handle/cursor/cache/root bytes.
resolution.selected_position: Test exact non-model G1 components on the target Linux host and claim only CPU interface isolation; bind the model path later.
resolution.required_change: Expand the visibility matrix to constructor, renderer, allocator, comparer, compiler, index, candidates, prompt builder, assigner, parser, evaluator, audit sink, and suffix generator. Forbid hidden completion, orbit, pair/side, attempt, law, answer, proof, posterior, score, condition, and prior outcome from visible handles, ordering, phrasing, length, ranks, timing, retries, repairs, and branches. Freeze constant-shape errors and all state resets.

disagreements.issue: Whether random 48-bit locators are an exact barrier.

positions.position: Use independently drawn 48-bit locators and reject guessed or non-visible handles.
Probability of a missed collision is not an exact theorem; enforce capabilities by emission origin.

resolution.rationale: Locator secrecy is not relied upon. The pointer reader maintains a sealed per-item, per-evaluator capability ledger. Target-visible handles are initial capabilities. A locator becomes valid only after that exact byte string was emitted by an authorized prior read in the same evaluator instance. Guessed, cross-item, cross-side, cross-cell, cross-life, expired, malformed, and unissued locators all return the same fixed-shape error, cost the same budget, and expose no membership, rank, work, or timing signal. The oracle enumerates capability state as policy state.
resolution.selected_position: Origin-gated capabilities, not unguessability, define pointer visibility.
resolution.required_change: Implement and independently enumerate the capability ledger, duplicate semantics, collision handling, constant resource accounting, and reset boundaries; random locator width is cosmetic only.

disagreements.issue: Which Candidate-B mechanisms are safely deleted and how the minimality timebox is enforced without weakening validity.

positions.position: Delete production roster, schemas, broad mutations, and packaging; keep the minimal causal spine.
Name safe and fatal deletions explicitly.
Freeze counting domains and redesign rather than approximate if a bound is exceeded.

resolution.rationale: KEEP: 384-world theorem; 192 twins; total no-rejection generator; four independent pairs; 64-item crossing; J environmental and informational cuts; P precommit chronology and schema ablation; literal independent oracle; target-byte and Bayes enumeration; SEM primary assay; PTR diagnostic with origin capabilities; typed value-1 controls; wrong twin; exact non-model evaluator path; target-host run/skip isolation; manifests; claim firewall. DELETE: N/O/R/X strata; 64-pair CPU release campaign; 3,072-role registry; reserves; production balance marginals; general record family and 17-schema release layer; broad M1-M9 mutation platform; cross-platform containment; public benchmark packaging; DREAM/SLEEP/LoRA/model training; calibration/confirmation; automatic G1/G2 dispatch. Resource envelope: at most 2,500 non-test logical lines across all executable subject plus oracle source under one frozen AST-based Python logical-statement counter; one worker; wall time strictly under 10,000 ms on the named Linux target host after warm filesystem cache; aggregate subject-plus-oracle peak RSS strictly under 268,435,456 bytes; fewer than 100,000 enumerated transition edges; temporary bytes strictly under 33,554,432; sealed evidence strictly under 16,777,216; zero network/model/GPU calls. Maximum implementation investment is ten working days and an absolute two-calendar-week redesign boundary. A bound failure triggers simplification of noncausal machinery or abandonment, never pruning, approximation, threshold weakening, self-oracling, synthetic isolation, or automatic revival of Candidate B.
resolution.selected_position: Implement only the named causal spine inside frozen strict resource bounds; archive everything else.
resolution.required_change: Bind the AST counter version, file manifests, Linux OCI image digest, CPU model, warmup procedure, `/usr/bin/time -v` plus container accounting method, transition definition, byte roots, worker count, and strict inequality semantics in the human-ratified scope before editing subject/oracle code.
